136: def deposit(shape, x, y, values):
137:     image = np.zeros(shape, float)
138:     ix, iy = np.floor(x).astype(int), np.floor(y).astype(int)
139:     fx, fy = x - ix, y - iy
140:     for dx, dy, weight in (
141:         (0, 0, (1 - fx) * (1 - fy)),
142:         (1, 0, fx * (1 - fy)),
143:         (0, 1, (1 - fx) * fy),
144:         (1, 1, fx * fy),
145:     ):
146:         xx, yy = ix + dx, iy + dy
147:         use = (xx >= 0) & (xx < shape[1]) & (yy >= 0) & (yy < shape[0])
148:         np.add.at(image, (yy[use], xx[use]), values[use] * weight[use])

188:     cx, cy = out_wcs.world_to_pixel_values(cra, cdec)
